attested_features.quote: A large central portal with surrounding side-doors was made in the wall dividing the cella, which became the church's nave, and from the rear chamber, the church's narthex.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: The Parthenon was built in the 5th century BC in thanksgiving for the Greek victory over the Persian invaders during the Greco-Persian Wars.
scenes.quote: The Parthenon was built in the 5th century BC in thanksgiving for the Greek victory over the Persian invaders during the Greco-Persian Wars.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: Construction started in 447 BC when the Delian League was at the peak of its power.
scenes.quote: Construction started in 447 BC when the Delian League was at the peak of its power.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: It was completed in 438 BC; work on the artwork and decorations continued until 432 BC.
scenes.quote: It was completed in 438 BC; work on the artwork and decorations continued until 432 BC.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: In the final decade of the 6th century AD, the Parthenon was converted into a Christian church dedicated to the Virgin Mary.
scenes.quote: In the final decade of the 6th century AD, the Parthenon was converted into a Christian church dedicated to the Virgin Mary.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: After the Ottoman conquest in the mid-15th century, it became a mosque.
scenes.quote: After the Ottoman conquest in the mid-15th century, it became a mosque.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: In the Morean War, a Venetian bomb landed on the Parthenon, which the Ottomans had used as a munitions dump, during the 1687 siege of the Acropolis.
